d: As a member of Munich Re the MedNet Global Health Care Solutions L.L.C. is one of the leading managed care service organizations that caters to healthcare needs. We are currently looking for a Officer – FWA supports the execution of claims audits and investigations to detect, review, and report potential Fraud, Waste, and Abuse (FWA). The role focuses on assisting in off-site and on-site audits of claims files, ensuring accurate documentation, timely reporting, and compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. The position contributes to cost containment and payment integrity initiatives under supervision.
Conduct claims audits to identify potential Fraud, Waste & Abuse (FWA) indicators and ensure compliance with internal policies and controls.
Prepare audit samples, perform off-site and on-site audits, and maintain accurate audit documentation and case files.
Investigate discrepancies, escalate suspicious findings to the Team Lead, and monitor pending cases through to resolution and recovery.
Prepare clear audit summaries, case reports, and final audit reports for management review and case closure.
Analyze provider irregularities, utilization trends, and payment discrepancies to identify potential risks and improvement opportunities.
Produce weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual FWA reports, including audit findings, sampling methodology, recoveries, and outcomes.
Prepare and submit regulatory FWA reports in accordance with applicable compliance and reporting requirements.
Maintain audit logs, recovery trackers, and other reporting tools to ensure accurate monitoring of audit activities and performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, promote knowledge sharing, and provide regular productivity updates to the Team Lead on planned versus completed activities.
q: A bachelor’s degree in insurance, Medicine, Paramedicine, or related discipline is required.
1-3 years’ experience within the insurance market (TPA, Insurance Company, or Healthcare Provider).
Proven experience conducting on-site and off-site audits and handling FWA investigations in the market.
*Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunity employer.

d: Role Description The Research Assistant is a part-time, remote role supporting clinical and health-related research activities for Asociación sin fines de lucro. Day-to-day tasks include conducting literature reviews, assisting with study design and protocol development, and collecting and organizing research data. The role also involves performing basic data analysis, preparing summaries and reports, and supporting the development of presentations and publications. The Research Assistant will collaborate with medical and research staff, maintain accurate documentation, and adhere to ethical and regulatory guidelines relevant to health research.
q: Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Data Analysis capabilities for interpreting research findings and managing datasets.
Candidates should possess solid Research skills, including literature review, information gathering, and documentation of study procedures.
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and preparing clear written reports.
Candidates should possess basic Laboratory Skills, where applicable, to support data collection and safe handling of samples or materials.

Additional preferred qualifications include attention to detail, organizational skills, ability to work independently in a remote setting, and familiarity with statistical or data management software.
A background in public health, medicine, biology, or a related field, and prior research experience or academic projects, are considered an advantage.
